claims.disproof_condition: Lower substitutability when another ex-China producer reaches sustained commercial separated-REO production (e.g., MP heavy separation facility, Seadrift Texas plant, or Brazil ionic-clay projects ramp); this claim's uniqueness scope is time-stamped 2025-10-30 and must be rechecked each quarter.
claims.statement: Lynas self-describes as the only outside-China commercial producer of separated light and heavy rare earth oxides. Self-reported (L8), but structurally corroborated by USGS 2026: US net import reliance for heavy rare earths is 100% and terbium imports are 100% from China, and by Mining Weekly's report of first ex-China Tb oxide production at Lynas Malaysia. For ex-China magnet supply chains, substitutability judged 4/5 (not 5: within-China supply is abundant and other separation projects are funded and under construction).
